1.1 Recommended operating condition
Recommended normal operation is within 5 to 60 °C and 20 to 80 %RH. Extended exposure outside this range can temporarily offset the humidity signal.

3.1 Power pins
Decouple the power supply pins with a 100 nF capacitor as close to the sensor as possible.

requirements.condition: Power supply pins; capacitor placed close to the sensor

If nRESET is connected to VDD, use a series resistor of R ≥ 2 kΩ. If unused, leaving nRESET floating is recommended.

3.2 Serial clock and serial data
SCL clock frequency can be selected from 0 to 1000 kHz. Communication up to 400 kHz must meet I2C Fast Mode; higher frequencies must follow Table 21.

3.4 ADDR pin
The ADDR pin selects the I2C address. Its logic level must remain constant from the I2C start condition until communication finishes.
